meta.bit_reading_note: each position's label names its job; in the wait test (circuit W-no, W-ref; part W) c0 to c4 are the end lines' results (manacitra.wait.WAIT_TEST_ROUNDS) and c5 is M's; in the other circuits M is measured into the label's m_clbit and the other bits read 0. meta.description: Kickoff 58, the placement comparison on ibm_kingston, in two jobs, on Kickoffs 55 and 56's three chains, fixed by the rule: 6-7-8, 42-43-44 and 31-18-11. Job 1, the sweep: per chain, R1(phi) at phi in {0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300} degrees; 18 circuits, each 2 copies of 2000 shots. From job 1's counts, each chain's peak phase phi* (peaks), recorded before job 2 was built. Job 2: per chain, W-no and R1 at phi* and at +90, W-ref and Z, for the verdict, each 2 copies of 3000 shots; beside it, R0 at phi* and at +90, each 2 copies of 1500 shots; 24 circuits. Each job in one random order; the sampler's own dynamical decoupling and twirling off, as IBM recorded them.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0

built_from.how: the chains fixed by the rule; the circuits by manacitra.wait at this commit, unedited, as in Kickoff 57 (build_wait_ramsey, build_wait_test); Z outside the package (Kickoff 50's, hw_50.py), translated by manacitra.wait.to_backend and scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled; against the live ibm_kingston target at each build (dt 4 ns)

T_M.definition: from the end of M's first H (its first sx) to the start of its last H (its last sx), in the wait test without refocusing (W-no) as scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled on the live target

fixed_before_the_data.rule: H58a on 7, H58b on 43, H58c on 18: D = |d1(+90)| - |d1(phi*)|, the same chain's cells in one job; PEAK SMALLER if D's 90% interval lies entirely above +band; PLUS-90 SMALLER if entirely below -band; NOT SEPARATED otherwise. d1(phi) = F_no(phi) - F_ref (1 - loss_R1(phi)), loss = M's P(1) minus its P(1) in Z, F against the wait test's phi = 0 parity ideal; phi* from job 1 by Kickoff 57's procedure, recorded before job 2 was built
fixed_before_the_data.bootstraps: one joint bootstrap, seed bootstrap, n_boot draws, the copies with replacement and each drawn copy's shots redrawn, phi* held fixed, in the order analyse_58.py fixes: per chain, F for W-no(phi*), W-no(+90), W-ref, then P(1) for Z, R1(phi*), R1(+90); then R0 at phi* and +90 per chain; then job 1's R1 at the six phases per chain

design.peak_procedure: Kickoff 57's analyse_57.peaks, unchanged: OLS of M's P(1) over the six phases (analyse_52.fit, theta_R); theta_R1 = atan2(s, -b); phi* = 180 - theta_R1 wrapped to [0, 360), rounded to the nearest whole degree (halves up); from the point estimate
design.translation: the package's build_wait_test / build_wait_ramsey; outside it (Z), manacitra.wait.to_backend (Qiskit preset pass manager, optimization_level 0, initial layout the chain, seed_transpiler 47) and manacitra.wait.scheduled

offline_build.what: the dry run before the go: the same circuits built for qiskit-ibm-runtime's offline ibm_kingston snapshot, whose durations differ from the live target's, so its T_M and timings differ; its own draw on the snapshot's published values, and job 2 built at the peaks from job 1's exact values and at stated peaks; not sent

chains_fixed.note: fixed by k58-rule.md (Kickoffs 55 and 56's chains), not drawn

peaks.rule: k58-rule.md: per chain, M's P(1) with the copies pooled; OLS fit c + b cos(phi) + s sin(phi) over the six phases; theta_R1 = atan2(s, -b); phi* = 180 - theta_R1, wrapped to [0, 360), rounded to the nearest whole degree; from the point estimate only
peaks.what: the peak phases, computed from job 1's counts by the rule's procedure and recorded at computed_utc, before job 2 was built (the job 2 records name this file by its SHA-256)

def published(backend):
    """The chains' published errors, T1 and T2 at build time, beside Kickoff 56's (chains-56.json, at its build)."""
    props, t = backend.properties(), backend.target
    cz = {tuple(int(x) for x in k) for k in t["cz"].keys() if k is not None}

    def safe(fn, *a):
        try:
            v = fn(*a)
            return None if v is None else float(v)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def edge_err(a, b):
        errs = [safe(props.gate_error, "cz", [x, y]) for x, y in ((a, b), (b, a)) if (x, y) in cz]
        return None if (not errs or any(e is None for e in errs)) else max(errs)

    def operational(q):
        try:
            return bool(props.is_qubit_operational(q))
        except Exception:
            return False

    k56 = json.loads((K56_DIR / "chains-56.json").read_text())
    was = {tuple(c["chain"]): c["at_build"] for c in k56["chains"]}

        out.append({"chain": c, "M": m, "at_build": {"readout_error": {str(q): safe(props.readout_error, q) for q in c},

def made(qc, chain, backend, name):

def base(chain, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    no0 = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend)
    tl0 = K50.timed(K50.schedule(no0, backend, chain)[0], t, dt, chain)
    return no0, {"T_M": K50.window(tl0, chain[1]), "tl_no": tl0, "T": K50.window(tl0, chain[1])["T_dt"]}


def build_job1_chain(chain, backend):
    no0, info = base(chain, backend)
    c = {("R1", "sweep", phi): W.build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, phase=math.radians(phi)) for phi in PHIS1}
    return c, info, no0


def build_job2_chain(chain, backend, phi_star):
    no0, info = base(chain, backend)
    M = chain[1]
    c = {}
    for k, role, _ in JOB2:
        phi = {"peak": phi_star, "plus90": 90}.get(role, 0)
        if k == "W-no":
            c[(k, role, phi)] = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend, phase=math.radians(phi))
        elif k == "R1":
            c[(k, role, phi)] = W.build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, phase=math.radians(phi))
        elif k == "R0":
            c[(k, role, phi)] = W.build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, neighbours="idle", phase=math.radians(phi))
        elif k == "W-ref":
            c[(k, role, phi)] = W.build_wait_test(chain, True, backend)

def m_clbit_of(k):

def checks(chain, circ, info, no0, backend, job):
    """Section 1's checks on one chain's circuits. circ is keyed (circuit, role, phi)."""
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    T = info["T"]
    rec, tls = {}, {}
    # check 1 on the wait test (in job 1 it is built for the checks only, not submitted)
    ops0 = {a: int(b) for a, b in no0.count_ops().items()}
    rec["W-no unedited (checks)"] = {"count_ops": ops0, "structure_5cz_6meas_3reset": ops0.get("cz") == 5 and ops0.get("measure") == 6 and ops0.get("reset") == 3,
                                     "no_swap": ops0.get("swap", 0) == 0, "layout_as_drawn": list(no0.layout.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True)) == chain,
                                     "both_couplers_used": {tuple(sorted(no0.find_bit(q).index for q in i.qubits)) for i in no0.data if i.operation.name == "cz"} == {tuple(sorted((L1, M))), tuple(sorted((M, L3)))},
                                     "exact_F": W.fidelity(W.exact_distribution(no0), ideal)}
    rec["W-no unedited (checks)"]["exact_F_is_1"] = abs(rec["W-no unedited (checks)"]["exact_F"] - 1) < 1e-6
    exact = {}
    for (k, role, phi), c in circ.items():
        lay = [M] if k == "R0" else chain
        ins, _ = K50.schedule(c, backend, lay)
        tl = K50.timed(ins, t, dt, lay)
        tls[(k, role, phi)] = tl
        ops = {a: int(b) for a, b in c.count_ops().items()}
        init = list(c.layout.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True))
        p = W.exact_distribution(c)
        bit = lambda key, i: key[::-1][i] == "1"
        r = {"phi_deg": phi, "count_ops": ops, "no_swap": ops.get("swap", 0) == 0, "layout_as_drawn": init == lay,
             "non_delay_ops_only_on_chain": {c.find_bit(q).index for i in c.data if i.operation.name != "delay" for q in i.qubits} <= set(lay)}
        seq = K51.m_sequence(c, M)
        names = [n for n, _ in seq]
        if k.startswith("W"):
            r["exact_F"] = W.fidelity(p, ideal)
            r["exact_F_expected"] = math.cos(math.radians(phi) / 2) ** 2
            r["exact_F_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_F"] - r["exact_F_expected"]) < 1e-6
            r["structure_5cz_6meas_3reset"] = ops.get("cz") == 5 and ops.get("measure") == 6 and ops.get("reset") == 3
            r["both_couplers_used"] = {tuple(sorted(c.find_bit(q).index for q in i.qubits)) for i in c.data if i.operation.name == "cz"} == {tuple(sorted((L1, M))), tuple(sorted((M, L3)))}
            if k == "W-ref":
                r["pulses_on_M"] = K50.x_on(c, M) > K50.x_on(no0, M)
        else:
            mb = m_clbit_of(k)
            r["exact_P1_M"] = sum(v for key, v in p.items() if bit(key, mb))
            r["exact_P1_expected"] = 0.0 if k == "Z" else math.sin(math.radians(phi) / 2) ** 2
            r["exact_P1_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_P1_M"] - r["exact_P1_expected"]) < 1e-9
            exact[(k, role, phi)] = r["exact_P1_M"]
            w = K50.window(tl, M)
            r["M_window"] = w
            if k == "Z":
                r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == 0
            elif k == "R0":
                r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == W.even_wait(T, getattr(t, "granularity", 1) or 1)
                r["window_beside_T_M"] = {"idle_even_T_M_dt": w["T_dt"], "T_M_dt": T}
            else:
                r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == T
        if k in ("W-no", "R0", "R1"):
            i = names.index("sx")
            r["M_first_H_then_next"] = seq[i - 1:i + 3]
            if phi:
                r["phase_one_rz_after_first_H"] = (seq[i - 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 2][0] == "rz"
                                                   and abs(seq[i + 2][1] - float(phi)) < 1e-6 and names.count("rz") == 5)
            else:
                r["phase_none_at_0"] = names.count("rz") == 4
        if k == "W-no":
            j0, j1 = names.index("sx"), len(names) - 1 - names[::-1].index("sx")
            between = names[j0 + 1:j1]
            core = between[1:-1]
            if phi:
                core = core[1:] if core[:1] == ["rz"] else ["?"]
            r["M_ops_between_H"] = between
            r["check_cz_barrier_and_phase_only"] = set(core) <= {"cz", "barrier"} and core.count("cz") == 5
        rec[f"{k}|{role}|{phi}"] = r
    tab = {str(q): {"W-no unedited": K50.events(info["tl_no"], q),
                    **{f"{k}|{role}|{phi}": K50.events(tl, q) for (k, role, phi), tl in tls.items() if k in ("R1", "W-no")}} for q in (L1, L3)}
    same = all(v == tab[str(q)]["W-no unedited"] for q in (L1, L3) for v in tab[str(q)].values())
    rec["_neighbours"] = {"measure_reset_times": tab, "R1_and_W_no_same_as_W_no_unedited": same}
    good_fit = True
    if job == 1:
        y = np.array([exact[("R1", "sweep", p)] for p in PHIS1])
        th = float(A52.theta_R(y))
        rec["_exact_fit"] = {"theta_R1_deg": th, "phi_star_deg": A57.peak_phase(th), "pass": abs(th) < 1e-6 and A57.peak_phase(th) == 180}
        good_fit = rec["_exact_fit"]["pass"]
    flat = [v for kk, r in rec.items() if not kk.startswith("_") for v in r.values() if isinstance(v, bool)]
    return rec, all(flat) and same and good_fit


def build(backend, chains, job, phis=None):
    circ, recs, infos, ok = {}, {}, {}, True
    for chain in chains:
        n = str(chain[1])
        if job == 1:
            c, info, no0 = build_job1_chain(chain, backend)
        else:
            c, info, no0 = build_job2_chain(chain, backend, phis[n])
        r, good = checks(chain, c, info, no0, backend, job)
        ok = ok and good
        circ[n], recs[n], infos[n] = c, r, {"T_M": info["T_M"], "chain": chain}
    return circ, recs, infos, ok


def assemble(circ, chains, job):
    items = [(str(ch[1]), ch, k, cp) for ch in chains for k in circ[str(ch[1])] for cp in range(1, COPIES + 1)]
    perm = np.random.default_rng(SEEDS[f"order_job{job}"]).permutation(len(items))
    block_of = {(k, role): b for k, role, b in JOB2}
    circs, labels, shots = [], [], []
    for i in perm:
        n, chain, (k, role, phi), cp = items[i]
        block = "sweep" if job == 1 else block_of[(k, role)]
        part = "S" if job == 1 else ("W" if k.startswith("W") else "R")
        labels.append({"job": job, "M": int(n), "chain": chain, "circuit": k, "role": role, "phi_deg": phi, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": m_clbit_of(k),
                       "part": part, "block": block, "built_by": "outside the package (hw_50 Z)" if k == "Z" else "package"})
        circs.append(circ[n][(k, role, phi)])
        shots.append(SHOTS[block])
    return circs, labels, shots

"""Kickoff 58 analysis, fixed before the data (sections 3 and 4 of the kickoff; k58-rule.md).

The peak phase (from job 1, before job 2 is built): Kickoff 57's procedure, analyse_57.peaks (a byte-identical copy,
unchanged): per chain, M's P(1) with the copies pooled at phi = 0, 60, ..., 300; the OLS fit y = c + b cos(phi) +
s sin(phi) (analyse_52.py's fit and theta_R); theta_R1 = atan2(s, -b); phi* = 180 - theta_R1, wrapped to [0, 360) and
rounded to the nearest whole degree (halves up); from the point estimate only.

The verdict (job 2), per chain (7, then 43, then 18):
- loss = M's P(1) minus M's P(1) in Z; F_no and F_ref, the squared Hellinger overlap with the wait test's phi = 0
  parity ideal (manacitra.wait), pooled over the copies; the outcome keys in the repository's order;
- d1(phi) = F_no(phi) - F_ref (1 - loss_R1(phi)) at phi* and at +90; D = |d1(+90)| - |d1(phi*)|;
- 90% intervals (5th and 95th percentiles) from one joint bootstrap, seed 58, 10,000 draws, phi* held fixed; for each
  circuit the copies are drawn with replacement and each drawn copy's shots are redrawn (Kickoff 52's method: the
  same draw functions as analyse_52.py, analyse_53.py and analyse_57.py), in a fixed order: per chain, F for W-no(phi*),
  W-no(+90), W-ref, then P(1) for Z, R1(phi*), R1(+90); after the three chains, from the same generator, R0(phi*) and
  R0(+90) per chain (beside); then job 1's R1 at the six phases per chain (beside, refitting on every resample).

H58a on 7, H58b on 43, H58c on 18: PEAK SMALLER if D's interval lies entirely above +0.02; PLUS-90 SMALLER if
entirely below -0.02; NOT SEPARATED otherwise.

Beside the verdict (k58-rule.md's list): the margin test at each placement (informative if the loss_R1 interval lies
entirely above 0.2; the d1 interval inside, outside or across [-0.15, +0.15]); the original rule, d0 at both
placements and D0 = |d0(+90)| - |d0(phi*)|; job 1's fits beside Kickoff 56's theta_R1 and implied peaks; the drift
between the jobs; this run's +90 cells beside Kickoff 55's.

Usage: python analyse_58.py                 (Kickoff 58's files)
       python analyse_58.py --synthetic     (the peak procedure at stated theta 0, +40, -100; job 2 built so that D is
                                             +0.10, -0.10 and 0)"""

VERDICT_NAME = {"7": "H58a", "43": "H58b", "18": "H58c"}
SEED, N_BOOT = 58, 10_000
BAND, MARGIN, FLOOR = 0.02, 0.15, 0.2
PHIS1 = A52.PHIS
pct, wrap, near, fit, theta_R = A52.pct, A52.wrap, A52.near, A52.fit, A52.theta_R

def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def verdict_of(ci):
    lo, hi = ci
    if lo > BAND:
        return "PEAK SMALLER"
    if hi < -BAND:
        return "PLUS-90 SMALLER"
    return "NOT SEPARATED"


def margin_of(ci):
    lo, hi = ci
    if lo > -MARGIN and hi < MARGIN:
        return "inside"
    if lo > MARGIN or hi < -MARGIN:
        return "outside"
    return "across"


def analyse(labels1, counts1, labels2, counts2, phistar, order=ORDER):
    keys, q = reuse._wait_test_keys()

    def F(V):
        return np.sqrt(V / V.sum(-1, keepdims=True) * q).sum(-1) ** 2

    cells, bits, pooled = defaultdict(list), defaultdict(list), defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    for lab, cts in zip(labels2, counts2):
        key = (str(lab["M"]), lab["circuit"], lab["role"])
        if lab["part"] == "W":
            d = defaultdict(int)
            for k, n in cts.items():
                kk = k.replace(" ", "")[-W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS:]
                d[kk] += n
                pooled[key][kk] += n
            cells[key].append((lab["copy"], [d.get(k, 0) for k in keys]))
        else:
            o, t = A57.m_ones(lab, cts)
            bits[key].append((lab["copy"], o, t))
    for (M, p), v in A57.job1_bits(labels1, counts1).items():
        bits[(M, "R1-sweep", p)] = v
    for dd in (cells, bits):
        for k in dd:
            dd[k].sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

    def draw_F(key):
        V = np.array([x[1] for x in cells[key]], float)
        freq = V / V.sum(1, keepdims=True)
        idx = rng.integers(0, V.shape[0], size=(N_BOOT, V.shape[0]))
        return F(rng.multinomial(int(V[0].sum()), freq[idx]).sum(1))

    def draw_P(key):
        o = np.array([x[1] for x in bits[key]])
        t = np.array([x[2] for x in bits[key]])
        acc1, accn = np.zeros(N_BOOT), np.zeros(N_BOOT)
        for _ in range(len(o)):
            pick = rng.integers(0, len(o), size=N_BOOT)
            acc1 += rng.binomial(t[pick], o[pick] / t[pick])
            accn += t[pick]
        return acc1 / accn

    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    P = {k: sum(x[1] for x in v) / sum(x[2] for x in v) for k, v in bits.items()}
    Fp = {k: W.fidelity(dict(v), ideal) for k, v in pooled.items()}
    Fb, Pb = {}, {}
    for M in order:                                       # the verdict's draws
        for k in ((M, "W-no", "peak"), (M, "W-no", "plus90"), (M, "W-ref", "ref")):
            Fb[k] = draw_F(k)
        for k in ((M, "Z", "zero"), (M, "R1", "peak"), (M, "R1", "plus90")):
            Pb[k] = draw_P(k)
    for M in order:                                       # beside: the idle Ramsey
        for k in ((M, "R0", "peak"), (M, "R0", "plus90")):
            Pb[k] = draw_P(k)
    for M in order:                                       # beside: job 1's sweep
        for p in PHIS1:
            Pb[(M, "R1-sweep", p)] = draw_P((M, "R1-sweep", p))

    per = {}
    for M in order:
        z, zb = P[(M, "Z", "zero")], Pb[(M, "Z", "zero")]
        fr, frb = Fp[(M, "W-ref", "ref")], Fb[(M, "W-ref", "ref")]
        cell, cellb = {}, {}
        for role in ("peak", "plus90"):
            fno, fnob = Fp[(M, "W-no", role)], Fb[(M, "W-no", role)]
            c = {"phi_deg": phistar[M] if role == "peak" else 90, "F_no": fno, "F_no_ci90": pct(fnob)}
            for r, R in (("1", "R1"), ("0", "R0")):
                l, lb = P[(M, R, role)] - z, Pb[(M, R, role)] - zb
                d, db = fno - fr * (1 - l), fnob - frb * (1 - lb)
                c.update({f"loss_{R}": l, f"loss_{R}_ci90": pct(lb), f"d{r}": d, f"d{r}_ci90": pct(db)})
                cellb[(role, r)] = db
            c["informative_R1"] = c["loss_R1_ci90"][0] > FLOOR
            c["informative_R0"] = c["loss_R0_ci90"][0] > FLOOR
            c["d1_margin"] = margin_of(c["d1_ci90"])
            c["d0_margin"] = margin_of(c["d0_ci90"])
            cell[role] = c
        D = abs(cell["plus90"]["d1"]) - abs(cell["peak"]["d1"])
        Db = np.abs(cellb[("plus90", "1")]) - np.abs(cellb[("peak", "1")])
        D0 = abs(cell["plus90"]["d0"]) - abs(cell["peak"]["d0"])
        D0b = np.abs(cellb[("plus90", "0")]) - np.abs(cellb[("peak", "0")])
        # job 1's fit, and the drift
        ks = [(M, "R1-sweep", p) for p in PHIS1]
        y = np.array([P[k] for k in ks])
        yb = np.stack([Pb[k] for k in ks], -1)
        c0, b, s = (float(v) for v in fit(y))
        _, bb, sb = fit(yb)
        th, thb = float(theta_R(y)), theta_R(yb)
        ph = math.radians(phistar[M])
        p1_fit = c0 + b * math.cos(ph) + s * math.sin(ph)
        per[M] = {"verdict_name": VERDICT_NAME.get(M, M), "verdict": verdict_of(pct(Db)), "phi_star_deg": phistar[M],
                  "D": D, "D_ci90": pct(Db), "cells": cell, "F_ref": fr, "F_ref_ci90": pct(frb), "P1_Z": z, "P1_Z_ci90": pct(zb),
                  "original_rule": {"D0": D0, "D0_ci90": pct(D0b), "verdict_by_the_same_band": verdict_of(pct(D0b))},
                  "job1_fit": {"theta_R1_deg": th, "theta_ci90": pct(near(thb, th)), "amplitude": math.hypot(b, s), "amplitude_ci90": pct(np.hypot(bb, sb)),
                               "c": c0, "b": b, "s": s, "residuals": (y - A52._X @ np.array([c0, b, s])).tolist(), "P1": dict(zip(map(str, PHIS1), y.tolist())),
                               "kickoff_56_theta_R1_deg": K56_THETA_R1.get(M), "theta_minus_kickoff_56_deg": float(wrap(th - K56_THETA_R1[M])) if M in K56_THETA_R1 else None,
                               "kickoff_56_implied_peak_deg": K56_IMPLIED_PEAK.get(M)},
                  "drift": {"R1_P1_job2_at_phi_star": P[(M, "R1", "peak")], "R1_P1_job1_fit_at_phi_star": p1_fit,
                            "difference_P1": P[(M, "R1", "peak")] - p1_fit, "R1_loss_job2": P[(M, "R1", "peak")] - z,
                            "R1_loss_job1_fit_minus_job2_Z": p1_fit - z},
                  "plus90_beside_kickoff_55": {"d1_this_run": cell["plus90"]["d1"], "d1_ci90_this_run": cell["plus90"]["d1_ci90"], "d1_kickoff_55": K55_D1_PLUS90.get(M)}}
    return {**{VERDICT_NAME.get(M, M): per[M]["verdict"] for M in order}, "per_chain": per}


def synthetic():
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    ik = sorted(ideal)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)

    def w_counts(f, n):
        p = {k: f / 32 for k in ik}
        p["000001"] = 1 - f
        ks = list(p)
        x = rng.multinomial(n, [p[k] for k in ks])
        return {k: int(v) for k, v in zip(ks, x) if v}

    def r_counts(p1, n, bits=6):
        o = int(rng.binomial(n, min(max(p1, 0.0), 1.0)))
        if bits == 1:
            return {"0": n - o, "1": o}
        return {"0" * bits: n - o, "1" + "0" * (bits - 1): o}

    s2 = lambda x: math.sin(math.radians(x) / 2) ** 2
    ok = True
    # the peak procedure (Kickoff 57's, unchanged) at stated theta
    order3 = ["11", "22", "33"]
    th = {"11": 0, "22": 40, "33": -100}
    want = {"11": 180, "22": 140, "33": 280}
    exact = {M: A57.peak_phase(float(theta_R(np.array([s2(p + th[M]) for p in PHIS1])))) for M in order3}
    le, ce, ln, cn = [], [], [], []
    for M in order3:
        for cp in (1, 2):
            for p in PHIS1:
                lab = {"job": 1, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": "sweep", "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "S"}
                o = int(round(2000 * (0.02 + 0.9 * s2(p + th[M]))))
                le.append(lab); ce.append({"000000": 2000 - o, "100000": o})
                ln.append(lab); cn.append(r_counts(0.02 + 0.9 * s2(p + th[M]), 2000))
    got_e = {M: v["phi_star_deg"] for M, v in A57.peaks(le, ce, order3).items()}
    got_n = {M: v["phi_star_deg"] for M, v in A57.peaks(ln, cn, order3).items()}
    good = exact == want and got_e == want
    ok = ok and good
    print(f"peak procedure: stated theta {th}; on exact values {exact}; on synthetic counts at their expected values {got_e}; expected {want} | "
          f"{'PASS' if good else 'FAIL'} (beside: on counts with draw noise, 2 x 2,000 shots, {got_n})")
    # job 2 built so that D is +0.10 on 7, -0.10 on 43 and 0 on 18 (F_ref 0.9, Z 0.01, R1 loss 0.9 sin^2((phi + theta)/2))
    thR = {"7": 16, "43": -37, "18": -38}
    d_set = {"7": (0.12, 0.02), "43": (0.02, 0.12), "18": (0.06, 0.06)}       # (d1 at +90, d1 at phi*)
    want = {"7": "PEAK SMALLER", "43": "PLUS-90 SMALLER", "18": "NOT SEPARATED"}
    l1, c1, l2, c2 = [], [], [], []
    for M in ORDER:
        for cp in (1, 2):
            for p in PHIS1:
                l1.append({"job": 1, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": "sweep", "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "S"})
                c1.append(r_counts(0.01 + 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M]), 2000))
    ps = {M: v["phi_star_deg"] for M, v in A57.peaks(l1, c1, list(ORDER)).items()}
    for M in ORDER:
        for cp in (1, 2):
            for role, p in (("peak", ps[M]), ("plus90", 90)):
                loss = 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M])
                d = d_set[M][0] if role == "plus90" else d_set[M][1]
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "W-no", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "part": "W"})
                c2.append(w_counts(0.9 * (1 - loss) + d, 3000))
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "R"})
                c2.append(r_counts(0.01 + loss, 3000))
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R0", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 0, "part": "R"})
                c2.append(r_counts(0.01 + 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M] + 20), 1500, bits=1))
            l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "W-ref", "role": "ref", "phi_deg": 0, "copy": cp, "part": "W"})
            c2.append(w_counts(0.9, 3000))
            l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "Z", "role": "zero", "phi_deg": 0, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "R"})
            c2.append(r_counts(0.01, 3000))
    r = analyse(l1, c1, l2, c2, ps)
    pc = r["per_chain"]
    good = all(pc[M]["verdict"] == want[M] for M in ORDER)
    fit_ok = all(abs(wrap(pc[M]["job1_fit"]["theta_R1_deg"] - thR[M])) < 3 for M in ORDER)
    ok = ok and good and fit_ok
    print(f"job 2 built so that D is +0.10, -0.10 and 0 on 7, 43 and 18: phi* {ps}; got "
          f"{ {M: (pc[M]['verdict'], round(pc[M]['D'], 3), [round(x, 3) for x in pc[M]['D_ci90']]) for M in ORDER} }; expected {want}; "
          f"job 1 fits {'recover' if fit_ok else 'MISS'} the stated theta | {'PASS' if good and fit_ok else 'FAIL'}")
    print("synthetic overall:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return ok
